recommendations_for_parent_plan: Do not combine isolated statement Native guard and whole-source legacy Native call profile into a single unsupported-call rule.
A finite per-method policy resolver must run without user callbacks and must preserve argument-position descriptors, keyword names and protocol semantic_partition.
Guard starred positional shape before _connect_call_values/_match_parameters if unsupported; a late guard after callee parameter/return publication cannot justify AI replay.
Existing starred omission requires either real expansion protocol or explicit conservative residual/havoc; preserving the IR starred flag is prerequisite, not a complete semantic repair.
Do not claim kwargs frozenset preserves expansion ordering or duplicate occurrence multiplicity. Existing keyword residuals describe that limitation rather than prove keyword binding.
Keep all19 registered context policies and separately owned heap selector; this audit provides no basis for retiring policies or hiding legacy typing debt.
